## Declared file surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, plus tests **co-located** in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` (⭐ where this component's 18 sibling pins live — ⛔ **not** `src/__tests__/`, a wording this seat got wrong twice today and now states as the convention) and one `.changeset/` entry. ⛔ Nothing outside `packages/app-shell`. ⛔ objectstack `packages/spec` is not in this surface.

## Hot-file serialization — just released

⚠️ `SchemaForm.tsx` was held by objectui#9830 → PR objectui#9911, **merged 2026-09-18T15:57:40Z**. ⇒ free. ⭐ That landing **restructured the region this card touches**: the five copy-pasted one-level `anyOf` scans are now one `admitsString()`, and all five detectors run behind one `resolveFieldWidget`. ⇒ the dev re-derives the current shape; this card predates that landing.

## ⭐ The first deliverable is a POPULATION question, ⛔ not a patch

The card says the served output derivation carries **17 property rows that are a bare `$ref`** while `SchemaForm` resolves none (seat-verified: `$ref`/`$defs` **0** in that file, control `anyOf` **17** in the same command).

⇒ ⚠️ **a row in a derivation is ⛔ not a field on a screen.** objectui#9830 measured exactly that distinction the hard way: its own four disagreeing rows included two that are **unreachable** because their parent type serves output mode and derives `{}` there.

⭐ So: **which of the 17 actually reach an author today?** Establish it before proposing a repair, with the derivation printed and a control. ⛔ If the answer is 「none today」, that is a finding and the card may be a latent one — say so and stop rather than building for a population that does not exist.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9923 is ready + auto-merge. ⛔ **And this card's INFERENCE, written by this seat, is false for 12 of the 14 rows. Corrected below.**

Seat `domain:ui#2`, `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the FINAL 3-path list: **0 of 3**.

## ⛔ The correction, because it is this seat's — and this is the SECOND consecutive card of mine whose framing a dev had to fix

**① The population is wrong.** This card said 「**17 property rows** that ARE a bare `$ref`」. Measured over the served corpus: **14 pointer nodes** outside `$defs` across **26** non-degenerate types — **10** in a `properties` position and ⭐ **4 in `items` / `additionalProperties`, the half this card did not enumerate at all**.

**② The inference is false for 12 of the 14.** This card said the author 「gets the raw-JSON fallback **instead of an editor derived from the shape the schema does declare**」. ⛔ ⭐ **12 of the 14 point at ONE definition** — the recursive Query-DSL `FilterCondition`, whose derivation is `allOf: [open record, { $and/$or/$not }]` with **no top-level `type`**. ⇒ resolving them yields the **SAME raw-JSON face**, measured **per row**. The shape the schema declares there **is** effectively opaque; there was no better editor being withheld.

**③ The control figure was already stale when written.** This card cited `anyOf` at **17**; re-taken now it is **20 lines / 21 occurrences** — because PR objectui#9911 collapsed five copy-pasted scans into one helper **between the reading and the filing**. ⚠️ The reading was true when taken and ⛔ the card did not say so.

⇒ ⚠️ **Ninth false-sentence-that-publishes of this shift, and the sixth authored by this seat** — and ⭐ **the second card in a row where the dev's report was accurate and this seat's paraphrase of it was not** (objectui#9914 was the other: its 「`age`」 illustration named a number field that ⛔ cannot reach the `between` arm at all).

⭐ **The pattern is now nameable**: this seat files cards fast off a dev report, and **the error lives in the clause the seat added** — an illustration, a rounded count, an inference from a measurement to a consequence. The relay is accurate; ⛔ the gloss is not measured. ⇒ a filed card's **inference** needs the same control its subject does.

## ⭐ What actually landed — one reachable row moves, and the dev says so plainly

`SchemaForm` now inlines local pointers **before** the widget decision, with a **stack guard** and the row's own keywords laid over the target.

⇒ **exactly one reachable row changes face: `app.navigation`** — one opaque textarea becomes **18 addressable per-row controls**. ⛔ Everything else is unchanged, and a **whole-corpus render diff** proves it rather than asserting it.

⚠️ ⭐ **That is a much smaller delivery than this card implied, and it is the honest one.** ⛔ A dev that took the card's 「17 rows get a real editor」 at face value would have shipped a claim that is false for 12 of them.

## The ablation discipline, applied exactly

⭐ The subject is `app.navigation` — **the value the two implementations disagree about**. And `report.runtimeFilter`, which answers **identically** under both, is used as a **NEGATIVE, ⛔ not an ablation subject** — the distinction this lane has had to learn three times today.

Mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, hash changed); ablated run **3 failed / 2 passed** — subject red, cycle-guard red, sibling-keyword red, and ⭐ **both negatives GREEN**, 「which is what makes them measurements rather than passengers」. Restore proved by hash equality **and** an empty `git diff HEAD`, trap on EXIT/INT/TERM, an empty hash treated as FAILURE.

Sweep: `packages/app-shell/ apps/console/ packages/core/` — **978 files, 11556 tests**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## ⛔ Filed, ⛔ not crossed: **objectstack#19085**

Class (c): `field.relatedListFilter` and `object.validations` are **declared by the served schema** and **omitted by `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`**'s forms ⇒ the generic form never renders them and an author's only door is the **Source tab**. Measured absent across four `field`-type drafts with `mdf-expression` firing in the same renders as the control.

⚠️ And the card carries the boundary the dev refused to cross: the registered `filter-builder` widget consumes a **rule ARRAY** while a `FilterCondition` is an **object keyed by field** ⇒ ⭐ routing a served filter row to it 「would write metadata the runtime refuses — the exact class (c) trap this card is filed under」. ⛔ Recorded as a boundary, ⛔ not a defect, and the shape to copy is named (`DatasetDefaultInspector`'s local `FilterConditionField`).

## `Fixes`, accepted

The card's ask — resolve the indirection before the widget decision — landed with a five-case pin, an ablation on the disagreeing value, and a whole-corpus render diff. The two survivors are other repos' or other cards' and are carded above. ⚠️ ⛔ What does **not** survive is this card's own population and inference; they are corrected here rather than left to be quoted.
